paragraphs.text: 1. HIGH hath the Mighty risen before the dawning, and come to us with light from out the darkness.
Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations.
paragraphs.original: अग्निर्भानुना रुशता स्वङ्ग आ जातो विश्वा सद्मान्यप्राः
paragraphs.translit: agnirbhānunā ruśatā svaṅga ā jāto viśvā sadmānyaprāḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Thou, being born, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted among the plants in beauty, Agni!
paragraphs.original: स जातो गर्भो असि रोदस्योरग्ने चारुर्विभृत ओषधीषु ।
paragraphs.translit: sa jāto garbho asi rodasyoragne cārurvibhṛta oṣadhīṣu |

paragraphs.text: The glooms of night thou, Brilliant Babe, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from thy Mothers.
paragraphs.original: चित्रः शिशुः परि तमांस्यक्तून्प्र मातृभ्यो अधि कनिक्रदद्गाः
paragraphs.translit: citraḥ śiśuḥ pari tamāṃsyaktūnpra mātṛbhyo adhi kanikradadgāḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Here, being manifested, lofty Visnu, full wise, protects his own supremest station.
paragraphs.original: विष्णुरित्था परममस्य विद्वाञ्जातो बृहन्नभि पाति तृतीयम् ।
paragraphs.translit: viṣṇuritthā paramamasya vidvāñjāto bṛhannabhi pāti tṛtīyam |

paragraphs.text: When they have offered in his mouth their sweet milk, to him with one accord they sing forth praises.
paragraphs.original: आसा यदस्य पयो अक्रत स्वं सचेतसो अभ्यर्चन्त्यत्र
paragraphs.translit: āsā yadasya payo akrata svaṃ sacetaso abhyarcantyatra

paragraphs.text: 4. Thence bearing food the Mothers come to meet thee, with food for thee who givest food its increase.
paragraphs.original: अत उ त्वा पितुभृतो जनित्रीरन्नावृधं प्रति चरन्त्यन्नैः ।
paragraphs.translit: ata u tvā pitubhṛto janitrīrannāvṛdhaṃ prati carantyannaiḥ |

paragraphs.text: These in their altered form again thou meetest. Thou art Invoking Priest in homes of mortals.
paragraphs.original: ता ईं प्रत्येषि पुनरन्यरूपा असि त्वं विक्षु मानुषीषु होता
paragraphs.translit: tā īṃ pratyeṣi punaranyarūpā asi tvaṃ vikṣu mānuṣīṣu hotā

paragraphs.text: 5. Priest of the holy rite, with car that glitters, refulgent Banner of each act of worship,
Sharing every God through might and glory, even Agni Guest of men I summon hither.
paragraphs.original: प्रत्यर्धिं देवस्यदेवस्य मह्ना श्रिया त्वग्निमतिथिं जनानाम्
paragraphs.translit: pratyardhiṃ devasyadevasya mahnā śriyā tvagnimatithiṃ janānām

paragraphs.text: 6. So Agni stands on earth's most central station, invested in well-decorated garments.
paragraphs.original: स तु वस्त्राण्यध पेशनानि वसानो अग्निर्नाभा पृथिव्याः ।
paragraphs.translit: sa tu vastrāṇyadha peśanāni vasāno agnirnābhā pṛthivyāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Born, red of hue, where men pour out libations, O King, as great High Priest bring the Gods hither.
paragraphs.original: अरुषो जातः पद इळायाः पुरोहितो राजन्यक्षीह देवान्
paragraphs.translit: aruṣo jātaḥ pada iḷāyāḥ purohito rājanyakṣīha devān

paragraphs.text: 7. Over the earth and over heaven, O Agni, thou, Son, hast ever spread above thy Parents.
paragraphs.original: आ हि द्यावापृथिवी अग्न उभे सदा पुत्रो न मातरा ततन्थ ।
paragraphs.translit: ā hi dyāvāpṛthivī agna ubhe sadā putro na mātarā tatantha |

paragraphs.text: Come, Youthfullest! to those who long to meet thee, and hither bring the Gods, O Mighty Victor.
paragraphs.original: प्र याह्यच्छोशतो यविष्ठाथा वह सहस्येह देवान्
paragraphs.translit: pra yāhyacchośato yaviṣṭhāthā vaha sahasyeha devān
